name: Bloodlines
source:
Ancestors of the great Irish Sea Serpent (Oilliphéist), Morrigan and Sean, are bound to serve the great Mythical King, Tier, a cruel Leviathan who rules his people with an iron fist. The only way to leave the King's service...is to provide a successor of your own blood.

Morrigan the witch cannot have children and her brother, Sean, the King's Royal advisor, is asexual. They are bound to the castle, never ageing and never changing.  King Tier is adamant that Sean must have a child to continue his family bloodline.  

Play as Morrigan, who vows to do anything to protect her brother from the King's toxic demands.  

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/bloodlines]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伟大的爱尔兰海蛇（Oilliphéist）的祖先莫里根（Morrigan）和肖恩（Sean）注定要为伟大的神话国王蒂尔（Tier）服务，蒂尔是一个残酷的利维坦，用铁拳统治着他的人民。离开国王的唯一方法……就是提供一个与你有血缘关系的继承人。

女巫莫莉根不能生育，而她的弟弟、国王的皇家顾问肖恩是无性恋者。它们与城堡绑定，永不衰老，永不改变。王级坚信肖恩必须有一个孩子才能延续他的家族血统。

扮演莫瑞根，她发誓要尽一切努力保护她的兄弟免受国王的有毒要求。

[来自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/bloodlines]itch.io[/url]]
